thread_title: S. flava var. cuprea (Lois x best clone) 'copper body'
breadcrumb: S. flava var. cuprea (Lois x best clone) 'copper body'

posts.body_html:
Gosh! I grew out a pretty large seed batch of S. flava var. cuprea Lois x best clone, and out of hundreds of seedlings, pretty much most of them were gold! A few were standout: one clone turned solid red under optimal conditions, and this clone below, despite having all the leaves chopped off to the ground, colored up like I've never seen before!

The entire body seems to be coppery and the color on the lid is dark and well defined. Anyhow, has anyone ever seen a S. flava var. cuprea like this before?


Photos taken 4/1/15:






Look at that color on the lid!

posts.body_html:
After seeing these traps below, this might actually be one of the best cupreas in the collection. Jerry Addington told me, "what are you going to do when you get a better clone than S. flava var. cuprea 'best clone.'? C'mon now Jerry, I was in my teens when that name was made, I didn't have the foresight to think that far ahead.....in retrospect, his chocolate top cuprea is also damn nice, although I abused it a bit this year, so it's not looking its best at the moment.

New photos of S. flava var. cuprea 'copper body.' pics taken 4/24/16:




Love that green interior contrasting with the coppery exterior:


Ya BABY!
